Literally dot is at a price of Flash crashtr 0.9 as at the moment its at 1.37-1.38. And people are asking, is this a dead project, it is over? Is Polkadot gone the last 2 days. There are 7lacs transactions. Which in top 3 of the crypto community, projects, blockchains, After Ethereum, Cardano, these blockchains. There are these transactions on Polkadot in top 3. There are on No.3. In the whole crypto world. These are among top these transactions on Polkadot Number 3 in the Crypto World Second Second is after February 23rd the week we have By the time of February last, Polkadot ETFs can get approved Many people have asked me what is polkadot90 When I talked about this in November I made a video related to Polkadot 90. I am revealing the countdown, This countdown is ending on Mar 22nd, The period is ending on Mar 18th, But the time from onward is going to be 10 days, In which the ETF has been piled by Polkadot and SSC, Under NASDAQ, which is the largest index in the world, On the top of Stock Trading Wall Street, which is big money. It is backing Polkadot and now launching ETFs and filing polkadot as well as SEC wants approval its timeline is finished with SEC. We should get automatic approval as per the law. So first we have to approve polkadot's ETF approval anyway? Because PdE has come down but DOT's price is stuck. Big money will use up all the funds at a time but DOT's ETF is a big asset. I am not going to get into details about it later. A lot of the crypto projects are listed in 15 top crypto products. One of the main reasons why it is listed is that 15 top accounts are not easily published in the media. So, more and more people like me have come to know about PULCA's history, Even the educated ones like mine talk about PULCA Drought, You should have thought about filing an ETF after that because if you got the media removed or the mainstream narrative builders removed, there will be a reason behind it and we will get an automatic ETF approval too. This is a very positive and a bad thing about PolkaDot. On March 14, the 2.1 billion 2.1 billion will start and yearly DOT from issuance. Yearly DOT, that's 120,1-million. Our cap will start to limit because of total supply We can see that this is happening since March. So, you see how these things are connecting together, so you can see, how the same thing is getting added up and in March staking unboundage time is lower from 28 days to 1 to 2 days these things are getting positive when these values are stuck in the network and the automatic deadline of ETF is ending so this video is not for the fame but because of the comments it gets received a lot My research is now public due to the various questions that come to me about Polkadot. My investment is also in the top and I am investing in it personally and its reasons are also there today. I have been investing in Polkadot ever since its ETF has been filed. All these statements are just a coincidence? When it was not an ETF of NASDAQ. Would this just happen because the ETF of Nasdaq is filed So then there is a hard supply cap on it. Whatever polkadot anti-people are, or critics are Their always correct that Polkadot has its maximum supply but no supply cap Which because it never rises because If so much is there, that thing is getting end The reason of price suppression is getting over on March 14th. So if Polkadot number 1 is in my bags today then how do I feel? I feel proud. I feel that as if I bought Amazon shares in 2000. I feel as if I bought Nvidia in 2019. I feel as if I invested in Tesla in 2012. Did we take time to transit there? Tesla, Nvidia, Amazon, and Fibo. Is the situation like the one we had in Tesla in 2011-12? Do we need that much time in transition? Tesla, NVIDIA, Amazon, and other such companies did take time to push their prices to up. Were they really in disappointment? Absolutely, they were. Elon Musk's interview is where he is crying saying that the mentors are the only ones doubters he knows. So these times come when, when you catch a gem, by my research I use. And then after that, gem tears off and it goes at the prices that you cannot even imagine Solana went from $8 to $208, BNB also went from $200 & ETH went from $1500 to $190 So there can be some other options. So why not another project? If we go to XRP, where it reached from .25 to $4 So why not DoT? So you have to check everything So these are my two cents whether you invest on this or not, i am not saying this is good, it's worthless and a nonsense I have presented my opinion about factual based things like mathematics and the flow of the market And i am just presenting you all about it, you can agree or disagree with me I always say and i will say it again and i say for 10 people at the end Do what you like best in the end for yourself Thank you so much Jazaqallah
